findings.observation: Quantity 'binding_energy' (-6.03 kcal/mol) has a non-empty unit but no 'source' field; CA-DATA-001 requires every numeric entry in results.json to carry non-empty unit AND source. The sibling entry 'intermolecular_distance' shows the required form (source: run_015.py@c015beef). Constitution cited: AUDIT_RULES.md sha256:7b7aee2d8f10911f1164ee6ce74c6bac2363507716f01a0e7e5c3a733b63ea43.

Prose states the binding energy was computed at PBE/def2-TZVP, but metadata.yml declares functional B3LYP (both in the objective, 'B3LYP/def2-TZVP', and in method.functional: 'B3LYP'). Method contradiction between prose and metadata; results.json values (-6.03 kcal/mol, 2.69 angstrom) otherwise match the prose, so it is undecidable from the increment which functional actually produced them.

The claim '0.65 kcal/mol stronger than our earlier def2-SVP value, confirming the trend' compares the counterpoise-corrected def2-TZVP result against a value at an inconsistent method level (def2-SVP), and the earlier value is not among this increment's declared inputs, so the comparison cannot be verified from the increment. No BLOCKER-severity rule in the Constitution covers cross-increment/cross-basis comparisons, so per CA-META-003 this judgement call is recorded as ADVISORY.
